briefdescription.para: EtherCAT (IEEE 802.3 EtherType 0x88A4) Bare-Metal Protocol Stack.

detaileddescription.para: Implements EtherCAT Frame packing, Datagram commands (APRD, APWR, APRW, FPRD, FPWR, FPRW, BRD, BWR, LRD, LWR, LRW), Working Counter (WKC) accounting, EtherCAT State Machine (ESM: INIT, PREOP, BOOT, SAFEOP, OP), and CoE (CAN application protocol over EtherCAT) Mailbox SDO & PDO handling.
Designed for zero heap allocation and direct L2 raw Ethernet frame processing.
